outcome: Neonatal morbidity (composite of Apgar score <7 at 5 minutes, cord lactate >8 mmol/L, need for resuscitation, significant birth trauma, or neonatal intensive care unit admission)
Mode of delivery (forceps, vacuum, cesarean section)
cohort: Women undergoing operative vaginal birth or fully dilated cesarean delivery with singleton cephalic term fetuses
finding: The use of intrapartum ultrasound during operative vaginal birth was associated with fewer infants delivered in an unexpected position and reduced neonatal morbidity.
mod_finding: Intrapartum ultrasound use was associated with significantly more forceps births and a reduction in vacuum births.
